Title: Album of caricature prints
Medium: Album (consisting of 72 pages of blue paper, cardboard covers, leather binding), containing 91 pen lithographs (printed in black ink on buff-colored paper of various sizes, all laid down), 2 landscape drawings (in ink and wash on brown, and on off-white paper, loose) possibly by another hand, and 1 handwritten poem on laid white paper (also loose.)
Repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY
Credit Line: From the Robert Isaacson Collection, Gift of James David Draper, 2002
